item.title: Man jailed for 22 months after kicking kitten to death

item.title: 76% of New SaaS Buyers Now Choosing AI-Native Plans Over Traditional Software, SleekFlow Platform Data Shows

item.title: Is This The All-New Toyota GR Celica In Rally-Guise?
item.description: The World Rally Championship (WRC) has revamped its regulations for 2027 in a bid to lower costs and encourage more participation.
